notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetch obtains title, description, and favicon only, omits preview images, and is not automatically performed on every save.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark without duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag input is plain comma-separated text with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable filters.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, description, and tags, but there is no note field or note search.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and ordinarily matches nothing.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including quotation marks.
REF-BM-17: A bookmark can be assigned to an exclusive Read later collection, but there is no independent unread state.
REF-BM-18: The Read later collection provides a similar filtered list, but it is not an unread-state perspective.
REF-BM-19: There is no mark-as-read action or read state.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the complete current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The visible sort control is inert and offers no sort keys.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: No reversible archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive-versus-permanent-delete behavior is absent.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks list.
REF-BM-29: Saved dynamic bundles with search and included/excluded tags are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is inert and no display preferences are implemented.
